_meta.engagement: Demo: Creator Launch Screening — Which Product Should JasonTheWeen Launch?
_meta.notes: Demo run. Hypothetical: JasonTheWeen (Jason Nguyen), a Twitch content creator known for IRL/Just Chatting and gaming streams (2M+ followers; ex-FaZe, currently in the CORE creator group as of 2026), is weighing 5 launch ideas across domains (audio, peripherals, beverage, apparel, ingestibles). Panel = the creator's audience. Elicitation is framed 'if JasonTheWeen launched this' to measure creator-audience demand fit, not raw price-sensitive purchase. Creator context is injected neutrally. Swap creator by editing the name in survey_question.text and concept names.

concepts.name: JasonTheWeen Signature Gaming Headset
concepts.description: A signature wireless gaming headset. Low-latency wireless, tuned audio, memory-foam earcups built for long stream sessions, detachable mic. $99.

concepts.name: JasonTheWeen Custom Mechanical Keyboard
concepts.description: A signature 75% mechanical keyboard. Hot-swappable switches, custom signature keycaps, per-key RGB, aluminum case. $129.

concepts.name: JasonTheWeen Energy
concepts.description: A zero-sugar focus energy drink. 200mg caffeine plus L-theanine for focus during long streams, no crash, citrus flavor. $30 per 12-pack.

concepts.name: JasonTheWeen Premium Hoodie
concepts.description: A limited-drop heavyweight hoodie. Embroidered logo, oversized fit, premium fleece. $65.

concepts.name: JasonTheWeen Recovery Collagen Peptides
concepts.description: Unflavored hydrolyzed collagen peptides, 10g per serving, for joint and connective-tissue support during long sessions. Mixes into any drink. 30-serving tub, $34.

survey_question.text: If JasonTheWeen — a Twitch streamer known for his IRL and gaming streams — launched this product, how likely would you be to buy it?
